The man in black robe who was kicked away fell far away, but he immediately got up and continued to treat The master in black robes rushed forward. The man in black robes did not get up after he fell to the ground, and another figure appeared next to him. The two of them shook their riding whips, wishing that the horses could grow wings and fly back. After all, Qin Lie was feeling weak and was always ready to be attacked by his junior brother Qin Shou. "Very good, you can get out now!" , Mingxuan kicked Zhu Xinli away. After seeing the death of Zhihe, he could still think of countermeasures for ten years. This second senior brother Shang Rong was either an extraordinary person or an extremely boring person. After a long time, Shi Jingtian raised his head and wiped the tears on his face. Li Siguang's Jueyi cried once, and he cried once over Qin'er's death, and now he cried uncontrollably. It was extremely dark everywhere, and Mingxuan could not accurately determine what the monster looked like. To be cautious, Mingxuan did not choose to take the attack, but jumped out of the stone pit. According to Po Xuan's logic, it was indeed the case. Ye Yinfeng let go of the long stick in his hand, suppressing the joy of meeting again after a long separation. After shouting loudly, he paid no attention to the trembling official. "If you don't leave Tianhai, we can still protect you. Once you leave, it will be too late to rescue you." Fang Yuqin stamped her feet and said. Luo Feng turned around and ignored the others, looking at the bald man in the front. Mo Yu, if you pay some price, such as the news about the artifact throne in front of you, you will definitely get the help from the forces behind Mo Yu, so that you can recover your body and rise again. They have never been teased like this before. This kind of shame is really unforgettable for them. They were once sure of victory, but now they have completely lost. This feeling is really bad, or it is embarrassing. Hearing this, Fei Bao was startled. The name Di Cheng said just now seemed familiar, but he couldn't remember it for a moment. The center of Chang'an City, the closest to the Imperial City, was naturally the busiest and most expensive place. However, the next moment, the starry sky suddenly changed, and the distance that was so close suddenly widened. Those stars suddenly turned into meteor showers, and the momentum was extremely terrifying. "Why do you say that, the ten gods of Tianyun are great heroes, killing many cultivators from the outside world!" The ten gods of Shanxin suddenly felt uncomfortable. Yi Tianyun was his idol, so he must be unhappy. It was still early spring, and he was running around the whole village naked, rolling up and down the mountain, and his head was covered with blood.
